title: Juicy Canadian Hind Shank Roast
description: A low-fat winter roast featuring tender hind shanks wrapped in ti-leaf and slow-baked with broth and vegetables.
instructions: Season hind shanks with salt and pepper on all sides.
Heat a skillet over medium-high and sear shanks until browned, about 3 minutes per side.
Transfer shanks to a ti-leaf-wrap, placing onion, carrots, garlic, and broth at the bottom.
Sprinkle the remaining ingredients over the meat, cover tightly with the leaf-wrap.
Bake in preheated oven for 90 minutes, turning the wrap once halfway through.
After baking, let the roast rest for 10 minutes before unwrapping.
Slice the shanks, spooning the reduced broth over the meat.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
Serve hot as a hearty winter dinner.
